# Security reporting

Do not disclose credentials, patient information, or exploit details in a public issue or pull request. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting when it is enabled; otherwise contact the maintainer privately before sharing details.

Include the affected version, prerequisites, minimal reproduction, impact, and a suggested fix if available. Use synthetic accounts and records. Do not probe a deployment or consume paid provider services without the owner's permission.

If a credential has been exposed, revoke or rotate it first. Deleting a file or opening a fresh repository does not invalidate the credential or remove existing copies of its history.

This is a portfolio application, not a certified clinical system. Only the latest maintained release is reviewed for security fixes.
